answer: Time-locked escrow with fraud clawback stops Sybil attacks. First, every payment sits in escrow for 14 days, so fakes cannot grab and vanish. Second, any client can file a fraud claim with evidence during the hold. Third, proven fraud claws back the pay, forfeits a $40 bond, and suspends the agent 60 days. Fourth, clean agents with three full escrows earn a 3-day release. Faking 1,000 agents needs $40,000 in bonds plus $25,000 in job fees, lost if caught. Trust is a quartz terrace on a busy island market: the cash box opens only after the customer walks away happy.
